title: Sitting in with Papa Celestin and getting the job
summary: When Celestin's band played Monroe, Moore sat in, and the missing trombonist's job became his.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: So you were in the Phoenix area in Arizona for maybe a year at least or more?

When Celestin played the ballroom, they asked me to bring my horn and come and sit in, so I did. I sat in and low and behold I wanted to get off, I played enough horn for sitting in. So I turned around they had no trombone player, the trombone player had left. He had left and Celestin said, well, find out where he went. The people went out to look for him. He had gone back to New Orleans. So the story goes around in New Orleans, when I got to New Orleans with Celestin, he says this big Indian guy, the Chief, drove that man out of Celestin's band and run him back to New Orleans.
